text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, sugammadex is not listed on the FDA drug shortage database. Corvale East holds 100 units (30.7 days on hand at 3.3 units per day). Corvale General holds 61.71 units (14.7 days on hand at 4.2 units per day). The product label identifies Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC as labeler with manufacturing at MSD SUB MERCK.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show sugammadex is not currently listed on the drug shortage database as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides adequate supply at both campuses. No shortage exists per FDA records. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list and have acceptable inspection histories.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (buyer approves).
2. Qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. as secondary source (buyer approves, P&T committee approves formulary addition).
3. Qualify Somerset Therapeutics, LLC as tertiary source (buyer approves, P&T committee approves formulary addition).
4. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly (buyer).
5. Report inventory levels to P&T committee monthly (buyer).

Not recommended: Emergency purchases, allocation restrictions, or conservation protocols at this time.
